title: Realtime contract: `.dsrt` source + `.profile` measurement
preamble:
# Realtime contract: `.dsrt` source + `.profile` measurement

A rule file compiled with the `realtime` extension carries a
**realtime contract**: a set of caps the author guarantees the
engine will not exceed under any permitted input. The contract
lives in a sibling `.dsrt` file at compile time, gets embedded
into the produced `.dsc`, and is enforced at runtime.

Two YAML files use a shared schema:

- `foo.profile` — written by the profile binary; records what
  was observed during a workload. Pure measurement. Regenerated
  unilaterally whenever the profile binary runs.
- `foo.dsrt` — hand-authored realtime contract. Same schema as
  `.profile`. Read by the compiler when `realtime` is enabled.
  Required for any `realtime` compile to succeed.

The author's "commit point" is the compile. Once `foo.dsc` is
produced, the contract inside it is binding; subsequent edits
to `foo.dsrt` do not affect the deployed `.dsc`. To revise the
contract the author re-compiles.

This document defines the YAML schema, the `RealtimeContract` atom in compiled
`.dsc` files, the compile-time obligations of `realtime`,
and the runtime enforcement contract.

Prefix `RTCT`.

Parents:
- [RARC.4] format version discipline.
- [RBND] dialect / contract bindings.
- [LDIA] dialect mechanism (the `realtime` capability).
